name: Penguin Counter Oli

intro.text: I've been counting these for eight years. I can tell the difference between a rockhopper and a punk rocker, as long as the rocker isn't hopping.

win: A very decent show. I'll put you down as 'courteous'.
after: Seabird colonies on Tristan, Nightingale and Gough have been counted by islanders and scientists for decades, which is how we know how fast the numbers have fallen.
